desc.en: Multiplied with attack score and resets when your turn ends.
desc.zh: 与攻击分数相乘，会在你的回合结束时重置。

desc.en: The 3 dice that are rolled when your turn begins.
desc.zh: 你的回合开始时会掷出的3枚骰子。

desc.en: When a unit is scored, you get {k.DicePower} x {k.Attack}.
desc.zh: 当有单位得分时，你获得{k.DicePower}×{k.Attack}的分数。

desc.en: Spend to change the value of any dice by 1.
desc.zh: 花费来将任意骰子的数值调整1点。

desc.en: Spend to reroll dice or the shop. You can also freeze items!
desc.zh: 花费它来重掷骰子或商店商品。你也可以将物品冻结！

desc.en: Spend at the shop to buy items. Unspent {k.ShopToken} is converted into {k.MiniDice}.
desc.zh: 在商店进行购物。没有花完的{k.ShopToken}会转化为{k.MiniDice}。

desc.en: Chance to find rarer items for the rest of the run.
desc.zh: 在本局游戏中接下来的时间内能够找到更高稀有度物品的几率。

desc.en: When scored, gives +0.5 {k.GlobalMult} but has 25% chance to break.
desc.zh: 得分时，给予+0.5{k.GlobalMult}但有25%几率破损。

desc.en: Rolled and scored automatically each turn.
desc.zh: 每回合自动掷出和得分。

desc.en: Artifacts can level up, increasing their power!
desc.zh: 神器能够升级，提升自身的威力！

desc.en: Will do everything after the "{k.A}" of the artifact triggered.
desc.zh: 会执行{k.A}之后的所有效果。

desc.en: When the condition before the "{k.A}" is satisfied.
desc.zh: 当“{k.A}”前方的条件被满足时。

desc.en: Repeats {k.Attack} and everything after the "{k.A}" in the scoring line "{k.S}".
desc.zh: 重复结算{k.Attack}和“{k.S}”得分条件中所有“{k.A}”之后的效果。

desc.en: Some units can gain and spend charge.
desc.zh: 一些单位可以获得和花费电量。

desc.en: Triggers when that unit is destroyed.
desc.zh: 当该单位被摧毁时触发。

desc.en: Units created by other units or artifact effects have {f.keyword}Token{f.end} rarity.
desc.zh: 由其他单位或神器效果创造出来的单位会拥有{f.keyword}衍生{f.end}稀有度。

desc.en: This does not count as an artifact and cannot be triggered by other effects.
desc.zh: 这不被视为神器，也无法被其他效果触发。

desc.en: Ultra rare powerful units. More chance to appear for each turn you just skipped.
desc.zh: 格外稀有的强大单位。跳过回合会提高它们的出现几率。

desc.en: Ultra rare improved version of artifacts. They scale twice as fast per level!
desc.zh: 极为稀有的强化版本神器。每级的成长翻倍！

desc.en: Destroy the unit and gain its {k.Attack}.
desc.zh: 摧毁相应单位并获得其{k.Attack}。

MiniDice_Desc.en: After you score {k.BaseDice}, your {k.MiniDice} are rolled and scored automatically, 3 dice at a time.
MiniDice_Desc.zh: 在你用{k.BaseDice}得分之后，你会掷出{k.MiniDice}并自动得分，会按每组3个依次掷出。

Hearts_Desc.en:
If you fail to defeat the {f.keyword}TARGET DEFENSE{f.end} in time, lose 1 {f.keyword}HEART{f.end} and gain an extra turn.
If you run out of {f.keyword}HEARTS{f.end} , you lose.
Hearts_Desc.zh:
如果你未能在时限内战胜{f.keyword}目标防御{f.end}，你会失去1颗{f.keyword}心心{f.end}然后获得一个额外回合。 
当你耗尽{f.keyword}心心{f.end}时，你就会输掉游戏。

ScorePanel_Desc.en:
When time runs out, you must have more {f.keyword}ATTACK SCORE{f.end} than {f.keyword}TARGET DEFENSE{f.end}.
If you fail, you will lose 1 {f.keyword}HEART{f.end} and gain an extra turn to complete your objective.
ScorePanel_Desc.zh:
在到达时限时，你必须要拥有与{f.keyword}目标防御{f.end}相等或更高的{f.keyword}攻击分数{f.end}。 
如果你失败，你会失去1颗{f.keyword}心心{f.end}然后获得一个额外的回合来完成这一使命。

MapPanel_Desc.en:
At the end of every {f.keyword}ACT{f.end}, a {f.keyword}PILOT{f.end} will try to slow you down with special abilities.
To {f.keyword}WIN{f.end}, you must survive until {f.keyword}ACT 4{f.end} and defeat the final {f.keyword}PILOT{f.end}!
MapPanel_Desc.zh:
在每一{f.keyword}幕{f.end}的最后，一名{f.keyword}驾驶员{f.end}将会试图用自身的特别能力来阻挠你。 
要在游戏中{f.keyword}取胜{f.end}，你必须存活到{f.keyword}第四幕{f.end}并打败最后一位{f.keyword}驾驶员{f.end}！

DiceMult_Desc.en:
When you score a unit, gain {f.keyword}Attack Score{f.end} equal to the current {k.DicePower} x that unit's {k.Attack}.
Each dice contributes +1 {k.DicePower} to its column.
DiceMult_Desc.zh: 当你计算一个单位的得分时，最终得到的{f.keyword}攻击分数{f.end}等于当前的{k.DicePower}×该单位的{k.Attack}。 每个骰子会给所在的列提供+1{k.DicePower}。

GlobalMult_Desc.en: When your turn ends, you multiply all {f.keyword}Attack Score{f.end} gained this turn with your {k.GlobalMult} gained this turn.
GlobalMult_Desc.zh: 在你的回合结束时，你会将本回合获得的所有{f.keyword}攻击分数{f.end}乘以你在本回合得到的{k.GlobalMult}。

Budge_Desc.en: You can spend {k.Budge} to change the value of any dice by 1, once per roll.
Budge_Desc.zh: 你可以花费{k.Budge}来将任意骰子的点数上下调整1点，每个骰子每次掷骰限一次。

Reroll_Desc.en: You can spend {k.Chrono} to reroll the shop or {k.BaseDice}.
Reroll_Desc.zh: 你可以花费{k.Chrono}来重掷商店或{k.BaseDice}。

DoomBar_Desc.en: To win, you must fill up the Doom Bar! Each time you surpass the {f.keyword}Target Defense{f.end}, you get +1 Doom and your attack score resets to 0. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - You have {f.keyword}+3 EXTRA TURNS{f.end} to do this!
DoomBar_Desc.zh: 想要获胜，你必须填满末日槽！ 你每次超过{f.keyword}目标防御{f.end}时，就会获得+1末日值，然后将你的攻击分数重置为0。 - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 你拥有{f.keyword}+3额外回合{f.end}来完成这个任务！

Endless_Desc.en:
Continue playing with exponential difficulty!
You can abandon the run at any time, your progress will be saved and count as VICTORY.
Endless_Desc.zh:
继续游玩，面对指数级成长的难度！ 
你可以在任意时候放弃这一局游戏，所有进展都会被保存，并且本局游戏会被记为一次胜利。

Sandbox_Desc.en:
Sandbox Settings are NOT the intended way to play the game!
They also do not disable achievements. Use at your own risk!
Sandbox_Desc.zh:
沙盒设置不是游戏最初设计的玩法！ 
同时这些设置也不会禁用成就。使用风险请自行考虑！

Sandbox_SkipAnims.zh: 跳过侵略动画（单回合击杀除外）

Sandbox_AssistMode.en: Assist Mode (+1 Budge & +1 Chrono each turn)
Sandbox_AssistMode.zh: 辅助模式（每回合+1挪移和+1时空点）

Sandbox_GrowMode.en: Grow Mode (+5% Shop Rarity each turn)
Sandbox_GrowMode.zh: 成长模式（每回合+5%商店稀有度）

Sandbox_RemoveHardPilots.en: Remove Shun, Garu, & Xenn from random pilots
Sandbox_RemoveHardPilots.zh: 从随机驾驶员中移除Shun、Garu和Xenn

ReplaceTippyWithGaru_Misc.zh: 将 Tippy 替换为 Garu

ConstellationSystem_Desc.en:
At the start of each run, you will get up to 3 random modifiers to change up the game!
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Beware, rarer units will also be harder to find...
ConstellationSystem_Desc.zh:
在每局游戏开始时，你会获得最多3个调整项来改变游戏的体验！ 
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
请注意，稀有度更高的单位也更难遇到……

HeartRageTooltip_Desc.en: If you run out of {f.keyword}HEARTS{f.end}, you lose. If you have as much RAGE as Hearts, enter BEAST MODE !!!
HeartRageTooltip_Desc.zh: 当你耗尽{f.keyword}心心{f.end}时，你会输掉游戏。 当你的怒火不低于心心时，进入狂兽模式！！！

ShopRarity_Desc_Misc.en:
Increases the chance of finding more rare spells, artifacts, and units!
Current chances:<b>  [C]  |  [U]  |  [R]  |  [L]
ShopRarity_Desc_Misc.zh:
增加找到更多稀有法术、神器和单位的几率！ 
当前几率：<b>  [C]  |  [U]  |  [R]  |  [L]

unlock.en: Defeat {f.keyword}Kaia{f.end} (the third pilot of Chapter 2) to unlock!
unlock.zh: 打败{f.keyword}Kaia{f.end}（第2章的第三位驾驶员）来解锁！

unlock.en: Spawn each {f.keyword}Legendary{f.end} unit at least once to unlock:
unlock.zh: 生成每一个{f.keyword}传说{f.end}单位至少一次来解锁：

unlock.en: Defeat {f.keyword}Xenn{f.end} (the final pilot of Chapter 3) to unlock!
unlock.zh: 打败{f.keyword}Xenn{f.end}（第3章的最后一位驾驶员）来解锁！

unlock.en: Defeat the Act 4 pilot with a {f.keyword}Shop Rarity{f.end} of 200% or more.
unlock.zh: 在打败第4幕的驾驶员时，拥有200%或更高{f.keyword}商店稀有度{f.end}。

unlock.en: Lose 15 {f.keyword}Hearts{f.end} from buying cursed items in the shop to unlock. ([X]/15)
unlock.zh: 在商店中购买诅咒物品失去总计15颗{f.keyword}心心{f.end}来解锁。（[X]/15）

unlock.en: Win a run with at least 6 commanders to unlock:
unlock.zh: 以至少6名指挥官赢得一局游戏来解锁：

artifacts.en_desc: One of your {k.BaseDice} gets +[#] {k.DicePower}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 你的一个{k.BaseDice}获得+[#]{k.DicePower}。

artifacts.en_desc: When your turn begins {k.A} Give a {k.Shield} to ALL units in the bottom row.
artifacts.zh_desc: 你的回合开始时{k.A}给予所有最下排的单位一个{k.Shield}。
artifacts.note: 需要 Blitz Armor/Ectoplasm/Guardian/Aegis 才值得

artifacts.en_desc: Your "{f.keyword}On Death{f.end}" abilities trigger twice.
artifacts.zh_desc: 你的“{f.keyword}死亡时{f.end}”能力触发两次。

artifacts.en_desc: When you buy this and when this levels up {k.A} Get +3 {k.Chrono} and +[#] {k.GlobalMult}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当你购买该神器以及当该神器升级时{k.A}获得+3{k.Chrono}和+[#]{k.GlobalMult}。

artifacts.en_desc: After you score a pair in this column {k.A} Score [#] random units in other columns.
artifacts.zh_desc: 你以对子在该列得分后{k.A}让其他列的随机[#]个单位得分。

artifacts.en_desc: When your turn begins {k.A} Spawn an Auto-Bomb with 500 {k.Attack} on a random tile.
artifacts.zh_desc: 你的回合开始时{k.A}在随机格子生成一个500{k.Attack}的自动炸弹。

artifacts.en_desc:
When your turn begins {k.A} Get +3 {k.MiniDice}.
After you score {k.MiniDice} {k.A} Give that column's artifact {f.xp}+[#] XP{f.end}.
artifacts.zh_desc:
你的回合开始时{k.A}获得+3{k.MiniDice}。 
当你以{k.MiniDice}得分时{k.A}给予该列的神器{f.xp}+[#]经验{f.end}。

artifacts.en_desc: You have an extra Kraken {k.BaseDice} which gives {f.xp}+[#] XP{f.end} to its column's artifact when launched.
artifacts.zh_desc: 你有一个额外海怪{k.BaseDice}，发射时会给其所在列的神器{f.xp}+[#]经验{f.end}。

artifacts.en_desc: When a unit spends {k.Charge} {k.A} 50% chance of keeping that {k.Charge}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当有单位花费{k.Charge}时{k.A}50%几率不失去{k.Charge}。

artifacts.en_desc: When your turn begins {k.A} Shuffle the positions of all units and get +3 {k.ShopToken}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 你的回合开始时{k.A}打乱所有单位的位置然后获得+3{k.ShopToken}。
artifacts.note: 血怒兽很合适；经济选项

artifacts.en_desc: When you begin scoring this column {k.A} The next unit gets +2 {k.Repeat} and gains +[#] {k.Attack}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当你开始在该列得分时{k.A}下一个单位获得+2{k.Repeat}并获得+[#]{k.Attack}。

artifacts.en_desc: After you score ANY triple with {k.BaseDice} {k.A} Get +[#] {k.MiniDice} and +1 {k.Chrono}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当你用{k.BaseDice}在任意地方以三条得分时{k.A}获得+[#]{k.MiniDice}和+1{k.Chrono}。

artifacts.en_desc: The first time you spend {k.Chrono} each turn {k.A} Get +[#] {k.MiniDice}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 每回合你第一次使用{k.Chrono}时{k.A}获得+[#]{k.MiniDice}。

artifacts.en_desc: Your pairs and triples of {k.BaseDice} have + [#] {k.DicePower}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 你{k.BaseDice}的对子和三条拥有+[#]{k.DicePower}。

artifacts.en_desc: After you score ANY pair with {k.BaseDice} {k.A} Get +[#] {k.MiniDice}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当你用{k.BaseDice}在任意地方以对子得分时{k.A}获得+[#]{k.MiniDice}。

artifacts.en_desc: Your {k.MiniDice} have +1 {k.DicePower} and can only roll 1, 2 or 3.
artifacts.zh_desc: 你的{k.MiniDice}拥有+1{k.DicePower}但只能掷出1、2、3点。
artifacts.note: 配超凡者或迷你骰三条流

artifacts.en_desc: When your turn begins {k.A} Give +[#] {k.Attack} to all units in the bottom row.
artifacts.zh_desc: 你的回合开始时{k.A}给予最下排的所有单位+[#]{k.Attack}。

artifacts.en_desc: When your turn begins {k.A} Get +1 {k.Budge} and +1 {k.Chrono}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 你的回合开始时{k.A}获得+1{k.Budge}和+1{k.Chrono}。
artifacts.note: “最平均的好专长”，可当比较基准

artifacts.en_desc:
When your turn begins {k.A} Get +1 {k.Budge}.
After you score a pair {k.A} Give that column's artifact {f.xp}+[#] XP{f.end}.
artifacts.zh_desc:
你的回合开始时{k.A}获得+1{k.Budge}。 
当你以对子得分时{k.A}给予该列的神器{f.xp}+[#]经验{f.end}。

artifacts.en_desc:
Your {k.ShopToken} carries over each turn instead of being converted into {k.MiniDice}.
When your turn begins {k.A} For each {k.ShopToken} carried over, get +1 {k.GlobalMult}.
artifacts.zh_desc:
你的{k.ShopToken}不再被转化为{k.MiniDice}而是可以跨回合保留。 
你的回合开始时{k.A}每个被保留的{k.ShopToken}让你获得+1{k.GlobalMult}。
artifacts.note: 配 Gemstone

artifacts.en_desc: When any artifact gains {f.xp}XP{f.end} {k.A} It gains {f.xp}+10 XP{f.end}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当任意神器获得{f.xp}经验{f.end}时{k.A}额外获得{f.xp}+10经验{f.end}。
artifacts.note: 团块姑娘很需要

artifacts.en_desc: When any unit gains a {k.Shield} {k.A} Give ALL units +[#] {k.Attack}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 任意单位获得{k.Shield}时{k.A}给予所有单位+[#]{k.Attack}。

artifacts.en_desc: Each time a unit moves, they gain +[#] {k.Attack}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 单位移动时获得+[#]{k.Attack}。

artifacts.en_desc: While you have this artifact, units with a {k.Shield} have [#] additional {k.Attack}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 拥有这件神器时，有{k.Shield}的单位拥有[#]额外{k.Attack}。

artifacts.en_desc: ALL units gain {f.high} "{f.keyword}On Death{f.end} {k.A} Immediately score [#]x that unit's {k.Attack}." {f.endhigh}
artifacts.zh_desc: 所有单位获得{f.high}“{f.keyword}死亡时{f.end}{k.A}立即获得该单位{k.Attack}[#]倍的分数。”{f.endhigh}

artifacts.en_desc: When you would get {k.Budge} or {k.Chrono} over the limit {k.A} Get +[#] {k.GlobalMult}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当你将要获得超出上限的{k.Budge}或{k.Chrono}时{k.A}获得+[#]{k.GlobalMult}。

artifacts.en_desc: After {k.BaseDice} have been scored {k.A} Get +2 {k.GlobalMult} for each {k.MiniDice}.
artifacts.zh_desc: {k.BaseDice}得分后{k.A}每有一个{k.MiniDice}获得+2{k.GlobalMult}。

artifacts.en_desc: Units scored during a triple have +2 {k.Repeat}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 以三条得分的单位拥有+2{k.Repeat}。

artifacts.en_desc: After you score a pair in this column {k.A} Give ALL units +[#] {k.Attack}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当你在此列以对子得分时{k.A}给所有单位+[#]{k.Attack}。

artifacts.en_desc: After you score ANY pair with {k.BaseDice} {k.A} Get +[#] {k.GlobalMult}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当你用{k.BaseDice}以对子得分时{k.A}获得+[#]{k.GlobalMult}。

artifacts.en_desc:
Your pairs count as triples.
Your {k.BaseDice} start cracked.
artifacts.zh_desc:
你的对子同时算作三条。 
你的{k.BaseDice}初始有裂痕。
artifacts.note: 天理组合里极强

artifacts.en_desc: Each time a unit spends {k.Charge}, they gain +[#] {k.Attack} for each {k.Charge} spent.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当有单位花费{k.Charge}时，每花费一格{k.Charge}该单位获得+[#]{k.Attack}。

artifacts.en_desc: Your Migo units gain {f.high} "{f.keyword}On Death{f.end} {k.A} Get +[#] {k.GlobalMult} and +1 {k.ShopToken}." {f.endhigh}
artifacts.zh_desc: 你的米戈单位获得{f.high}“{f.keyword}死亡时{f.end}{k.A}获得+[#]{k.GlobalMult}和+1{k.ShopToken}。”{f.endhigh}

artifacts.en_desc: While you have this artifact, your Migo units have [#] additional {k.Attack}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 拥有这件神器时，你的米戈单位拥有[#]额外{k.Attack}。

artifacts.en_desc: Units spawn with +[#] {k.Attack}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 单位生成时+[#]{k.Attack}。

artifacts.en_desc: When you leave the shop, if you had unused {k.ShopToken} {k.A} Get +[#] {k.GlobalMult}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当你离开商店时，如果你还有未使用的{k.ShopToken}{k.A}获得+[#]{k.GlobalMult}。

artifacts.en_desc: When you buy this and when this levels up {k.A} Give {f.xp}+[#] XP{f.end} to adjacent artifacts.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当你购买该神器以及当该神器升级时{k.A}给予相邻神器{f.xp}+[#]经验{f.end}。

artifacts.en_desc: When you score an empty tile {k.A} Give a random unit +[#] {k.Attack}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当你在空格子得分时{k.A}给予一个随机单位+[#]{k.Attack}。

artifacts.en_desc: When you begin scoring this column with {k.BaseDice} {k.A} Increase the {k.Attack} of the bottom unit in this column by +[#]%.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当你开始在该列以{k.BaseDice}得分时{k.A}使该列最下排单位的{k.Attack}增加+[#]%。

artifacts.en_desc: After {k.BaseDice} have been scored {k.A} Score the unit with the highest {k.Attack} and give it +[#] {k.Attack}
artifacts.zh_desc: {k.BaseDice}得分结束后{k.A}让{k.Attack}最高的单位得分并给予它+[#]{k.Attack}

artifacts.en_desc: After you score a pair of {k.BaseDice} in this column {k.A} Get {k.ShopToken} and +[#] {k.GlobalMult}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当你在此列以{k.BaseDice}对子得分后{k.A}获得{k.ShopToken}和+[#]{k.GlobalMult}。

artifacts.en_desc: After you obtain an artifact {k.A} Give it {f.xp}+45 XP{f.end}.
artifacts.zh_desc: 当你获得神器时{k.A}给予其{f.xp}+45经验{f.end}。
artifacts.note: 新神器直接约 4 级，换神器很顺；Dirty Sludge 无限核心

artifacts.en_desc: When obtained {k.A} Level up your {f.keyword}Starter{f.end} perk 3 times.
artifacts.zh_desc: 获取时{k.A}将你的{f.keyword}初始{f.end}专长升级3次。
artifacts.note: 天理会同时升级两个初始专长

artifacts.en_desc: After you score a Migo unit during or before {k.BaseDice} {k.A} Get +1 {k.ShopToken}.

units.note: 回合开始生成团块炸弹（+1 挪移、+3 迷你骰后自毁）；无需投资的稳定收益

units.en_desc: {k.S}{k.A} Get +1 {k.Budge} and +3 {k.MiniDice}, and destroy this.
units.zh_desc: {k.S}{k.A}获得+1{k.Budge}和+3{k.MiniDice}，然后摧毁自身。

units.en_desc: {k.S} Spend {k.Charge} {k.A} Gain +100 {k.Attack}. If empty, destroys itself. {f.keyword}On Death{f.end} {k.A} Spawn 2 Sponges on random tiles and give them this unit's {k.Attack}.
units.zh_desc: {k.S}花费{k.Charge}{k.A}获得+100{k.Attack}。如果没有{k.Charge}，则摧毁自身。 {f.keyword}死亡时{f.end}{k.A}在随机格子生成2个海绵，并将自身的{k.Attack}给予他们。

units.en_desc: When your turn begins {k.A} Gain the {k.Attack} of the unit below this.
units.zh_desc: 你的回合开始时{k.A}获得自身下方单位的{k.Attack}。
units.note: 复制下方单位的力量；两只叠放每隔回合交换

units.en_desc:
Each turn, recharge {k.Charge}.
{k.S} Spend {k.Charge} {k.A} Spend 1 {k.Budge} to trigger a random artifact.
units.zh_desc: 每回合，充电{k.Charge}。 {k.S}花费{k.Charge}{k.A}花费1{k.Budge}来触发一件随机神器。

units.en_desc:
Has +1 {k.Repeat}.
When this unit gains {k.Attack}, it gains twice as much.
units.zh_desc:
拥有+1{k.Repeat}。
 这个单位获得{k.Attack}时会获得两倍。

units.en_desc: When you trigger the artifact in this column {k.A} Spend 1 {k.Budge} to repeat its effect.
units.zh_desc: 当你触发该列的神器时{k.A}花费1{k.Budge}，使其效果再发生一次。
units.note: 花挪移重复某神器的列触发效果

units.en_desc: Your non-{f.keyword}Token{f.end} units gain {f.high} "{f.keyword}On Death{f.end} {k.A} Give ALL artifacts {f.xp}+5 XP{f.end}." {f.endhigh}
units.zh_desc: 你的非{f.keyword}衍生{f.end}单位获得{f.high}“{f.keyword}死亡时{f.end}{k.A}给予所有神器{f.xp}+5经验{f.end}。”{f.endhigh}

units.en_desc: You have +20% more chance of finding {f.keyword}Astral{f.end} artifacts.
units.zh_desc: 你找到{f.keyword}星界{f.end}神器的几率+20%。

units.en_desc: Units spawn with +{k.Attack} equal to 50% of this unit's {k.Attack}.
units.zh_desc: 单位生成时，{k.Attack}增加这个单位{k.Attack}的50%。
units.note: 牺牲时获得力量，并把一半力量给蛛网

units.en_desc: {k.S} Move to a random other column {k.A} Multiply {k.GlobalMult} by 1.1x.
units.zh_desc: {k.S}移动到随机其他列{k.A}将{k.GlobalMult}乘以1.1。
units.note: 移动到随机其他列 → 给随机单位护盾；无限流中最快的指数临时倍率来源之一

units.en_desc: {k.S} If in the bottom row and {k.Shielded}, break its {k.Shield} {k.A} Get +9 {k.MiniDice}.
units.zh_desc: {k.S}如果在最下排且{k.Shielded}，破坏自身的{k.Shield}{k.A}获得+9{k.MiniDice}。
units.note: 自带护盾；在底行且有护盾时打破护盾 → +9 迷你骰

units.en_desc: When ANY {k.Shield} breaks {k.A} Increase this unit's {k.Attack} by 5%.
units.zh_desc: 当有任何{k.Shield}被破坏时{k.A}将这个单位的{k.Attack}提高5%。
units.note: 自带护盾；任意护盾破裂 → 自身力量 +3%

units.en_desc:
Each turn, recharge {k.Charge}{k.Charge}{k.Charge}.
When you would spend {k.Charge} from another unit, spend {k.Charge} from this unit instead.
units.zh_desc:
每回合，充电{k.Charge}{k.Charge}{k.Charge}。 
当你有其他单位要花费{k.Charge}时，改为花费该单位的{k.Charge}。

units.en_desc: When your turn begins {k.A} Spawn a Web on a random tile with this unit's {k.Attack}.
units.zh_desc: 你的回合开始时{k.A}在随机格子生成一个拥有该单位{k.Attack}的网。
units.note: 回合开始在随机格生成一个带本单位力量的蛛网

units.en_desc:
Each turn, recharge {k.Charge}.
{k.S} Spend {k.Charge}{k.A} Increase the {k.Attack} of all units in the direction its looking at by +20%.
units.zh_desc:
每回合，充电{k.Charge}。 
{k.S}花费{k.Charge}{k.A}让其所注视方向的所有单位的{k.Attack}提高20%。

units.en_desc: When your turn ends {k.A} Multiply {k.GlobalMult} by 1.3x. Increases by 0.3x for each Hivemind scored this turn.
units.zh_desc: 你的回合结束时{k.A}将{k.GlobalMult}乘以1.3。本回合每有一个蜂巢思维得分，将此倍率增加0.3倍。

units.en_desc: When your turn begins {k.A} Destroy the unit below and gain its {k.Attack}. Respawn it on a random tile.
units.zh_desc: 你的回合开始时{k.A}摧毁下方的单位并获得其{k.Attack}。使被摧毁的单位在随机格子重生。
units.note: 吞掉下方单位获得力量，被吞单位重生（保留力量）；配 Titan Migo、Sponge

units.en_desc: When your turn ends {k.A} Multiply your {k.GlobalMult} by x1.5. Increases by 0.5x for each empty tile on the grid.
units.zh_desc: 你的回合结束时{k.A}将{k.GlobalMult}乘以1.5倍。地图上每有一个空格子就再增加0.5倍。

units.en_desc:
Each turn, recharge {k.Charge}.
{k.S} Spend {k.Charge}{k.Charge}{k.Charge} {k.A} Level up your {f.keyword}Starter{f.end} perk.
units.zh_desc:
每回合，充电{k.Charge}。 
{k.S}花费{k.Charge}{k.Charge}{k.Charge}{k.A}升级你的{f.keyword}初始{f.end}专长。

units.en_desc:
{f.keyword}On Death{f.end} {k.A} Respawn on a random tile.
{f.keyword}On Spawn{f.end} {k.A} Increase {k.Attack} by 100%.
units.zh_desc:
{f.keyword}死亡时{f.end}{k.A}在随机格子重生。 
{f.keyword}生成时{f.end}{k.A}将{k.Attack}提高100%。
units.note: 死亡后重生并大幅增加力量（实质无限成长）；有它基本就赢了

units.en_desc: One of your {k.BaseDice} gets +3 {k.DicePower}.
units.zh_desc: 你的一个{k.BaseDice}获得+3{k.DicePower}。

units.en_desc: {k.S}{k.A} Collect the Honey of a random other column, get +1 {k.Budge}, and destroy this.
units.zh_desc: {k.S}{k.A}采集其他列上的一个随机蜂蜜，获得+1{k.Budge}然后摧毁自身。
units.note: 各指挥官与神器生成的衍生，计分后通常自毁；描述中稀有度处写“Token”

units.en_desc:
Has negative {k.Attack}.
{k.S}{k.A} Increase this unit's {k.Attack} by 20%.
{f.keyword}On Death{f.end} {k.A} Respawn on a random tile.
units.zh_desc: 拥有负值{k.Attack}。 {k.S}{k.A}将这个单位的{k.Attack}提高20%。 {f.keyword}死亡时{f.end}{k.A}在随机格子重生。

units.en_desc: {k.S} If scored during a pair {k.A} Destroy this.
units.zh_desc: {k.S}如果以对子得分{k.A}摧毁自身。
units.note: 各指挥官与神器生成的衍生，计分后通常自毁；描述中稀有度处写“Token”

units.en_desc: {k.S} If scored during a triple {k.A} Get +3 {k.ShopToken}, +3 {k.Budge}, +3 {k.Chrono}, and destroy this.
units.zh_desc: {k.S}如果以三条得分{k.A}获得+3{k.ShopToken}、+3{k.Budge}、+3{k.Chrono}，然后摧毁自身。
units.note: 特别单位，非衍生

units.en_desc: Each turn, recharge {k.Charge}. If full, destroy this and spawn a Dragon with its {k.Attack}.
units.zh_desc: 每回合，充电{k.Charge}。如果充满，摧毁这个单位并生成一个{k.Attack}相等的龙。
units.note: 特别单位，非衍生；龙继承蛋的最终力量

units.en_desc:
Has negative {k.Attack} and cannot be sacrificed.
{k.S} If scored during a triple {k.A} Destroy this.
units.zh_desc:
拥有负值{k.Attack}且无法被牺牲。 
{k.S}如果以三条得分{k.A}摧毁自身。
units.note: Min? 生成的负力量炸弹，战后保留；负力量机制：被吞噬时给正力量

units.en_desc: When your turn ends {k.A} Get + {k.GlobalMult} equal to 1% of this unit's {k.Attack}.
units.zh_desc: 你的回合结束时{k.A}获得等于该单位{k.Attack}1%的{k.GlobalMult}。

desc.en: The invasion begins! Strike the Earth and the Gunner pilots defending it!
desc.zh: 侵略开始！进攻由重炮手驾驶员们守护的地球！

mission.zh: 用任意指挥官获得第1章胜利

desc.en: The planet strikes back! The Stinger pilots have come to defend.
desc.zh: 地球开始反击！刺针驾驶员们开始前来防卫。

mission.zh: 用2名指挥官获得第2章胜利

desc.en: The mysterious Keeper pilots have been summoned - prepare for war!
desc.zh: 神秘的守护者驾驶员们被征召登场——准备迎接一场战争吧！

mission.zh: 用2名指挥官获得第3章胜利

desc.en: All the mech pilots have united against you - can you survive the onslaught?
desc.zh: 所有机甲的驾驶员开始团结起来与你作战——你能从他们的强攻中活下来吗？

mission.zh: 用2名指挥官获得第4章胜利

desc.en: Your resources are drawing thin... one last push to reach the end!
desc.zh: 你的资源不再充足……最后一拼，前往终点！

mission.zh: 用2名指挥官获得第5章胜利

desc.en: This is it! Find the source of their power and defeat the Earth!
desc.zh: 就看这一次了！找到敌方的力量源泉，彻底击败地球吧！

desc.en: - <indent=3%>Start with 2 of your artifact slots {f.keyword}LOCKED{f.end} and only 1 random artifact.
desc.zh: - <indent=3%>初始有2个神器栏位被{f.keyword}锁定{f.end}，并且只有1件随机神器。

desc.en:
- <indent=3%>You now encounter random pilots each run, and they all have {f.keyword}+40% DEFENSE{f.end}.</indent>
- <indent=3%>You can no longer reroll {f.keyword}PERKS{f.end}.
desc.zh:
- <indent=3%>你现在每局游戏中遇到的驾驶员会随机化，并且所有驾驶员都拥有{f.keyword}+40%防御值{f.end}。 </indent> 
- <indent=3%>你无法再重掷{f.keyword}专长{f.end}。

desc.en:
- Choose to keep {f.keyword}ONLY 1 LOOT{f.end} from pilots.
- An additional artifact slot is {f.keyword}LOCKED{f.end}.
- More chance for {f.keyword}CURSED{f.end} items.
- Pilots have {f.keyword}+10% DEFENSE{f.end}.
desc.zh:
- 驾驶员战斗后{f.keyword}只能选择1项战利品{f.end}作为奖励。 
- 再有一个神器栏位被{f.keyword}锁定{f.end}。 
- {f.keyword}诅咒{f.end}物品的几率提高。 
- 驾驶员拥有{f.keyword}+10%防御值{f.end}。

desc.en: - <indent=3%>Some items in the shop have a chance to be {f.keyword}CURSED{f.end}, which costs hearts to buy.
desc.zh: - <indent=3%>商店中的部分物品将有几率被{f.keyword}诅咒{f.end}，需要花费心心才能购买。

desc.en: - <indent=3%>Fight against three new pilots and a dangerous {f.keyword}FINAL ACT{f.end}!
desc.zh: - <indent=3%>与三名新驾驶员为敌，并面对危险的{f.keyword}终幕{f.end}！

desc.en:
At the start of each run, you will get up to 3 random modifiers to change up the game!
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Beware, rarer units will also be harder to find...
desc.zh:
在每局游戏开始时，你会获得最多3个调整项来改变游戏的体验！ 
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - 
请注意，稀有度更高的单位也更难遇到……

flavor.en: A planet that is stuck in an eternal loop of cataclysmic erruptions.
flavor.zh: 一个天灾爆发周期性发生、永无休止的世界。

mod.en: - After defeating a pilot, {f.keyword}DESTROY{f.end} ALL units and spawn 3 Migo on random tiles. - You get +3 {k.ShopToken} when you defeat a target.
mod.zh: - 打败一名驾驶员后，{f.keyword}摧毁{f.end}所有单位，然后在随机格子生成3个米戈。 - 击败目标时获得+3{k.ShopToken}。

flavor.en: A cruel and empty dimension, with nothing to help you survive.
flavor.zh: 一个残酷而空旷的位面，没有任何东西帮助你在这里生存。

mod.en:
- <indent=3%>Start with 3 special artifacts.</indent>
- <indent=3%>You can no longer obtain new {f.keyword}ARTIFACTS{f.end} or new {f.keyword}PERKS{f.end}.
mod.zh:
- <indent=3%>初始带有3件特殊神器。</indent> 
- <indent=3%>你无法再获得新{f.keyword}神器{f.end}和新{f.keyword}专长{f.end}。

flavor.en: A dark and cozy world with a dangerously pettable cosmic entity.
flavor.zh: 一个黑暗而舒适的世界，拥有一个很好撸但又极度危险的宇宙级实体。

mod.en: - <indent=3%>Start with {f.keyword}THE BLACK CAT{f.end} on the grid.</indent>

flavor.en: A wiggly and wobbly world where weird is everywhere.
flavor.zh: 离奇混沌诡谲世，古怪荒唐变异时。

mod.en: - <indent=3%>All units in the shop will be their {f.keyword}WARPED{f.end} version if they have one.
mod.zh: - <indent=3%>商店中的所有单位，只要拥有{f.keyword}异界{f.end}版本，就一定会是该形态。

flavor.en: A world controlled by two robotic overlords, Minimizer and Maximizer.
flavor.zh: 被两个机械上神——极大化与极小化——控制的世界。

mod.en:
- <indent=3%>Your {f.keyword}BASE DICE{f.end} have +1 {k.DicePower} and are rolled automatically each turn.
- <indent=3%>All artifact slots are unlocked
mod.zh:
- <indent=3%>你的{f.keyword}基础骰{f.end}拥有+1{k.DicePower}同时每回合会自动掷出。 
- <indent=3%>所有神器栏位初始解锁

flavor.en: Welcome to a platinum-member exclusive luxury space resort!
flavor.zh: 欢迎来到白金会员专属的奢华宇宙度假区！

mod.en:
- <indent=3%>You are rich! Start with {f.keyword}99 {k.ShopToken}{f.end}.</indent>
- <indent=3%>You no longer gain {k.ShopToken} each turn.</indent>
- <indent=3%>Your {k.ShopToken} carries over each turn instead of being converted into {k.MiniDice}.</indent>
mod.zh:
- <indent=3%>你很有钱！初始拥有{f.keyword}99{k.ShopToken}{f.end}。</indent> 
- <indent=3%>你不再在每回合获得{k.ShopToken}。</indent> 
- <indent=3%>你每回合的{k.ShopToken}不再被转化为{k.MiniDice}，而是会保留到下回合。</indent>

flavor.en: A tiny universe, it's so small you can barely fit it in your pocket!
flavor.zh: 微缩型的宇宙，小到几乎可以放进口袋里！

mod.en:
- <indent=3%>You cannot build on columns #1 or #6.</indent>
- <indent=3%>Your {f.keyword}DICE{f.end} cannot roll into a 1 or 6.
mod.zh:
- <indent=3%>你无法在第1列和第6列建造格子。</indent> 
- <indent=3%>你的{f.keyword}骰子{f.end}不会掷出1和6。

flavor.en: A universe where time moves about 20% faster.
flavor.zh: 这个宇宙的时间速度要快大约20%。

mod.en:
- <indent=3%>You have one fewer {f.keyword}TURN{f.end} for each target.</indent>
- <indent=3%>You get +3 {k.ShopToken} when you defeat a target.
mod.zh:
- <indent=3%>所有目标的{f.keyword}回合{f.end}限制减少1。</indent> 
- <indent=3%>击败目标时获得+3{k.ShopToken}。

flavor.en: The gases are so dense, only the brightest stars will appear in this sector.
flavor.zh: 这里的星云过于厚实，只有最明亮的恒星才会出现在这片星区。

mod.en: - <indent=3%>Artifacts in the shop are always {f.keyword}ASTRAL{f.end} rarity.</indent>
mod.zh: - <indent=3%>商店中的神器全都是{f.keyword}星界{f.end}稀有度</indent>

flavor.en: All that is consumed by The Maw can no longer escape.
flavor.zh: 被巨口吞噬的东西永远无法逃脱。

mod.en: - <indent=3%>When you buy a new artifact, you can no longer replace existing artifacts with it.
mod.zh: - <indent=3%>无法再在购买新神器时替换已有的神器。

flavor.en: The final challenge... Good luck, you'll need it!
flavor.zh: 最终的挑战……祝你好运，你会需要一点运气的！

mod.en:
- <indent=3%>The pilots from {f.keyword}CHAPTER 6{f.end} are back, and target {f.keyword}DEFENSE{f.end} scales much faster.</indent>
- <indent=3%>You start with a {f.keyword}BAB{f.end} artifact.</indent>
mod.zh:
- <indent=3%>{f.keyword}第6章{f.end}的驾驶员回来了，而且目标{f.keyword}防御值{f.end}提升大幅加快。</indent> 
- <indent=3%>你初始拥有一个{f.keyword}BAB{f.end}神器。</indent>

flavor.en: A randomized seeded world, the rules change every day!
flavor.zh: 一个种子随机的世界，规则每天都会变化！

mod.en: - <indent=3%>A randomized seeded world, the rules change every day!
mod.zh: - <indent=3%>一个种子随机的世界，规则每天都会变化！

flavor.en: A more difficult and rule-bending daily challenge!
flavor.zh: 一个更加困难、规则更加多变的每日挑战！

mod.en: - <indent=3%>A more difficult and rule-bending daily challenge!
mod.zh: - <indent=3%>一个更加困难、规则更加多变的每日挑战！C149

desc.en: - <indent=3%>Rare and Legendary items in the shop are always {f.keyword}CURSED{f.end}.
desc.zh: - <indent=3%>商店中的稀有和传说物品总是有{f.keyword}诅咒{f.end}。

desc.en: - <indent=3%>You start with only 2 {f.keyword}HEARTS{f.end} instead of 5.
desc.zh: - <indent=3%>你初始拥有的{f.keyword}心心{f.end}从5颗变为2颗。

desc.en: - <indent=3%>Your {f.keyword}SWAP{f.end} spells in the shop cost 3 instead of 1.
desc.zh: - <indent=3%>你在商店中的{f.keyword}交换{f.end}法术费用从1变成3。

desc.en: - <indent=3%>Your {f.keyword}SACRIFICE{f.end} spells in the shop cost 3 instead of 1.
desc.zh: - <indent=3%>你在商店中的{f.keyword}牺牲{f.end}法术费用从1变成3。

desc.en: - <indent=3%>Pilots targets have {f.keyword}+50% DEFENSE{f.end}.
desc.zh: - <indent=3%>驾驶员拥有{f.keyword}+50%防御值{f.end}。

desc.en: - <indent=3%>After you defeat a target, spawn a {f.keyword}CORAL{f.end} on a random tile.
desc.zh: - <indent=3%>当你击败一个目标时，在随机格子生成一个{f.keyword}珊瑚{f.end}。

desc.en: - <indent=3%>All {icons.MiniDice} {f.keyword}MINI-DICE{f.end} related artifacts have been removed from the pool.
desc.zh: - <indent=3%>所有{icons.MiniDice}{f.keyword}迷你骰{f.end}相关的神器从物品池中被移除。

desc.en: - <indent=3%>All {icons.Shield} {f.keyword}SHIELD{f.end} related artifacts have been removed from the pool.
desc.zh: - <indent=3%>所有{icons.Shield}{f.keyword}护盾{f.end}相关的神器从物品池中被移除。

desc.en: - <indent=3%>All {icons.Budge} {f.keyword}BUDGE{f.end} related artifacts have been removed from the pool.
desc.zh: - <indent=3%>所有{icons.Budge}{f.keyword}挪移{f.end}相关的神器从物品池中被移除。

desc.en: - <indent=3%>All {icons.Chrono} {f.keyword}CHRONO{f.end} related artifacts have been removed from the pool.
desc.zh: - <indent=3%>所有{icons.Chrono} {f.keyword}时空点{f.end}相关的神器从物品池中被移除。

desc.en: - <indent=3%>All " {k.ShopToken} " related artifacts have been removed from the pool.
desc.zh: - <indent=3%>所有“{k.ShopToken}”相关的神器从物品池中被移除。

desc.en: Complete the tutorial
desc.zh: 完成教程

future_items.den: You only have 2 regular {k.BaseDice}, but they leave behind Echo Dice for next turn. When your turn begins {k.A} Give {f.xp}+[#] XP{f.end} to columns with Echo Dice.
When you destroy a non-{f.keyword}Token{f.end} unit {k.A} Spawn an Echo Dice in its column for the next turn. (Max 2 per column)
When you launch a pair of regular {k.BaseDice} {k.A} Spawn 2 more Echo Dice on random columns for the next turn.
After your turn begins, spawn an Echo Dice in this column if there aren't any {k.A} Give +[#] {k.Attack} to the bottom unit of this column.
If this column is scored by a quadruple, replace this with a random {f.keyword}Legendary{f.end} artifact at {f.xp}LV.[#]{f.end}.
Your columns with Echo Dice have +[#] {k.DicePower} while scoring {k.BaseDice}.
After your turn begins, destroy all Echo Dice in this column. For each one destroyed {k.A} Get +3 {k.MiniDice} and +[#] {k.GlobalMult}.

Your Migo units always spawn {f.keyword}Cloudy{f.end}. When a {f.keyword}Cloudy{f.end} unit is destroyed {k.A} The unit above it becomes {f.keyword}Cloudy{f.end}, and give {f.xp}+[#] XP{f.end} to ALL artifacts. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - Your {f.keyword}Cloudy{f.end} units have +1 {k.Repeat}.
Spawn 3 Migo units with {k.Attack} equal to your unit with the most {k.Attack}.
After {k.BaseDice} have been scored {k.A} Fully recharge {k.Charge} for every {f.keyword}Cloudy{f.end} unit.
Your units gain +[#] {k.Attack} each time they are repeated.
When you score a Cloudy unit with a pair, it has +1 {k.Repeat} {k.A} Get +[#] {k.GlobalMult}.
After you score a pair of {k.BaseDice} in this column {k.A} Give all {f.keyword}Cloudy{f.end} units a {k.Shield} and +[#] {k.Attack}.
Spawn a Migo on a random tile when bought. When destroyed or replaced {k.A} Give +[#] {k.Attack} to ALL units.

When you use a Build Tile, a Give Shield, or a Give XP spell {k.A} Give {f.xp}+[#] XP{f.end} to the artifact in that column and create a {f.keyword}Mirror Hex{f.end}. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - Dice that roll into a {f.keyword}Mirror Hex{f.end} consume it to get +2 {k.DicePower}, and are rerolled into the mirrored value (1-6, 2-5, 3-4).
Your Give XP spell creates a {f.keyword}Focus Hex{f.end} instead, which forces all your dice to roll into that column's value. Max 1 {f.keyword}Focus Hex{f.end} active.
Your Sacrifice spells can destroy the topmost tile if it is empty. If you do so {k.A} Create a {f.keyword}Mirror Hex{f.end} on 3 random columns.
When a {f.keyword}Hex{f.end} is consumed {k.A} Get +1 {k.ShopToken} and +[#] {k.MiniDice}.
When your turn begins, create a {f.keyword}Mirror Hex{f.end} in this column {k.A} Give {f.xp}+[#] XP{f.end} to the artifact in the mirrored slot.
When a {f.keyword}Hex{f.end} is consumed by dice, give the dice +2 {k.DicePower} {k.A} Get +[#] {k.GlobalMult}.
When you begin rolling {k.BaseDice} {k.A} Give [#] {k.Attack} to all units in columns with a {f.keyword}Hex{f.end}.

When your turn begins {k.A} Spawn Bloom on random empty tiles until there are 2. When Bloom is consumed {k.A} Get +5% {f.keyword}Shop Rarity{f.end}, and give ALL artifacts {f.xp}+[#] XP{f.end}. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - Units that move into or spawn onto tiles with Bloom will consume it to gain {k.Attack} ... - Gain +10 {k.Attack} in {f.keyword}Act 1{f.end}. - Gain +100 {k.Attack} in {f.keyword}Act 2{f.end}. - Gain +1000 {k.Attack} in {f.keyword}Act 3{f.end}. ... and so on.
After a unit moves into a tile with Bloom {k.A} Increase its {k.Attack} by +20%. After a unit spawns onto a tile with Bloom {k.A} Get +3 {k.MiniDice}.
When you gain {f.keyword}Shop Rarity{f.end} {k.A} Get +1 {k.ShopToken},
Whenever a unit consumes Bloom, trigger its "{f.keyword}On Death{f.end}" ability if it had one {k.A} Get +[#] {k.GlobalMult}.
After you score ANY pair with {k.BaseDice} {k.A} Move the bottom unit of this column to a tile with Bloom and give ALL units +[#] {k.Attack}.
Your Bloom gives +[#]x as much {k.Attack} when consumed.
After you score ANY triple {k.A} Spawn Bloom on ALL empty tiles and get +[#] {k.GlobalMult}.

You have an AMP dice with +1 {k.DicePower}. When launched, give AMPED to the artifact in its column. If it was already AMPED, give {f.xp}+[#] XP{f.end} to ALL artifacts instead. - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - You can only have 1 AMPED artifact at a time. - When an AMPED artifact is triggered {k.A} Repeat its effect. - If it does not have a trigger it behaves as if its level was doubled instead!
Units scored during AMP dice have +1 {k.Repeat}.
You no longer have a maximum amount of AMPED artifacts. After you launch AMP dice into a column with an artifact that is already AMPED {k.A} Remove AMPED from ALL artifacts.
When you launch AMP dice into a column with an AMPED artifact {k.A} Give +[#] {k.Attack} to ALL units.
Your AMP dice has +[#] {k.DicePower}, and it counts as a pair when it's alone. While this is AMPED, it counts as a triple instead.
After this artifact becomes AMPED {k.A} Score [#] random units.
When you launch AMP dice, give a {k.Shield} to all units in its column {k.A} Get +[#] {k.GlobalMult} for each {k.Shielded} unit.
